trade.name: signed_trade_volume_imbalance
trade.definition: rolling sum(side * qty) / rolling sum(qty); side sign comes from compacted trade stream

label_rules.DIRECTIONAL: event_count >= min_support and mean_signed_fwd_return_bps >= min_edge_bps and t_stat >= min_t_stat
label_rules.ANTI_EDGE: event_count >= min_support and mean_signed_fwd_return_bps <= -min_edge_bps and t_stat <= -min_t_stat
label_rules.NO_EDGE: event_count >= min_support but no directional or anti-edge pass
